rules.label: On probation
rules.rule: Facility Status is ON PROBATION in the current snapshot.

rules.label: Substantiated allegations, last 12 months
rules.rule: The facility is not closed and the state's complaint detail lists at least one substantiated allegation on a complaint dated on or after the same calendar day one year before the as-of date.

rules.label: Closed or changed status, last 90 days
rules.rule: The facility had a License First Date and its Closed Date is within the last 90 days, or our weekly comparison recorded a status change within the last 90 days. Weekly comparisons start with the first snapshot we hold.

rules.label: 3+ complaints, last 12 months
rules.rule: The facility is not closed and the state's complaint detail lists 3 or more complaints dated in the last 12 months. This counts complaints, not complaint visits, because only the complaint detail carries dates.

disclaimer: Flags come from public state records, may be out of date, and do not indicate a facility's quality or value. Each flag is shown on its own; they are not added together. Errors in a record can only be corrected by the California Department of Social Services.
